97636e93f38a11cd94a2.en: There are 7 days in a week.

603bc9f9492e23baeb49.en: After Sunday, the week starts again with Monday.
603bc9f9492e23baeb49.id: Setelah Sunday, minggu baru dimulai lagi dengan Monday.

cbc9e2b1f686f8381afa.en: There are 12 months in a year.

5ac2f8c6fbaa2e4d7115.en: Yesterday is the day before today. Tomorrow is the day after.
5ac2f8c6fbaa2e4d7115.id: Yesterday berarti kemarin, yaitu hari sebelum hari ini. Tomorrow berarti besok, yaitu hari sesudah hari ini.
